note: Commentator Anik says the UFC is internally discussing an immediate Gaethje-Topuria rematch, then calls his own view 'non-informed speculation'. Act could be predicts_his_fight rather than a leak; next_fight is 'yes' on the 'internal discussions' claim, but it is thin.

Column about Gaethje sitting out 2026 and the lightweight queue; Topuria appears as the man Gaethje beat and in one line, 'Gaethje has said he won't rematch Topuria'. Nobody does anything regarding Topuria beyond that refusal, so act is none_of_these; centrality could be one_of_several since the article discusses their fight, and the refusal could be read as next-fight news.

A DJ sampled a Pimblett quote at Creamfields; Topuria is one line at the end: Pimblett ruled out fighting him and expects him back next year. Pimblett is only rumoured against him, so other_fighter not opponent_side; declining a fight and guessing a return year fits no act, closest is gives_news_of_him.

Ukrainian fight report: Donchenko beat Soriano by unanimous decision at UFC Paris, round by round. His wish to fight Daniel Rodriguez next is paraphrased, not quoted, so he_speaks is no and next fight is a wish only.
Gaethje says he wants McGregor, not rematches with Holloway or Oliveira; Topuria is mentioned only as the man Gaethje beat and who had beaten those two. Nobody does anything regarding Topuria.

Long Spanish interview with Javier Mendez, mostly about Makhachev, Garry and Joel Alvarez; four questions cover Topuria (best boxing in MMA, will come back stronger, why he lost, the Makhachev fight makes no sense for now). Could be only_mentioned given the share; Mendez is the coach of Makhachev, long publicly linked to a Topuria fight, so opponent_side, but none_of_these (another fighter's coach) is arguable.

Topuria's own essay on the loss: he lists fractured orbital bones, a broken septum and a broken foot, and says defeat made him want to return more. The piece is mainly reflection, so no_fact is arguable, but the injuries are stated as his own news.
Masvidal on a podcast calls Amosov a stylistic nightmare for Makhachev, praising his wrestling, size and reach. Opinion only; the video list is page furniture.

Anik says there are 'internal conversations' about Gaethje vs Topuria 2, then calls it his speculation; Gaethje's plans get equal space. Could be main_subject (framed as 'what is next for Topuria'), act could be predicts_his_fight, and next_fight 'yes' rests on the internal-talks claim alone. Orbital fractures recalled as background.

Usman Nurmagomedov denies elbowing Song Yadong; Topuria appears only in a 'LATEST NEWS' link about Gaethje's hands. Source answered for the main content (Usman's own statement); no act regarding Topuria.

Gaethje explains how he beat Topuria: emotional mistakes in camp, feet that never change rhythm. Rematch rumours are mentioned in passing (Anik's belief), not as this article's news, so next_fight stays no.
Podcast transcript with Gaethje about golf, charity tournaments and retirement; Topuria is named only in the intro blurb as the man he beat. Nobody does anything regarding Topuria.

UFC.com preview built on Donchenko's quotes about his growth, his French, Soriano and rankings, ahead of their Paris fight on Saturday. The booking is already known, so no_fact is arguable; I took the set opponent and date as the article's fact.

Jesus Gallo, one of his physical trainers, says recovery from the orbital and nasal fractures is going better than expected: physically ready by December is possible, but 2027 is the sensible target. Next fight 'yes' on the readiness timeline, which is deliberately vague.

Post-fight in Paris: Donchenko asks for Daniel Rodriguez next (a wish, so next_fight no) and explains the late takedown; the unanimous-decision win over Soriano is reported with scorecards the same weekend. The headline news is the callout, so no_fact is arguable and the result could be read as background.
RAF Moscow wrestling card losing its US stream; Topuria appears only in a 'LATEST NEWS' link. Source answered for the main content (the outlet and an ESPN report); no act regarding Topuria.

Odds and pick for Donchenko vs Soriano at UFC Paris, covering both men; pick is Donchenko by decision. The pick is opinion, so no_fact is arguable; I took the set bout as the fact. The text wrongly calls him a debutant and misnames Berggren.

Makhachev's coach Mendez says Topuria's loss changed the course of a Makhachev fight, he needs more than one win first and is too small for welterweight. Could be one_of_several (Makhachev's UFC 330 win gets a paragraph); Mendez is opponent_side only via the long-discussed Makhachev fight, none_of_these (another fighter's coach) is arguable.

Topuria, in a TBC advert in Georgia, promises to come back stronger; no date or opponent, so no fact. The quote comes from an advert but is still his words; rematch and Pimblett talk is mentioned as rumour in passing, not as news.

Topuria's social-media letter to his son Hugo about losing and character, reproduced in full. The outlet frames it as announcing his return, but the letter names no fight, date or opponent, so next_fight is no; the letter is a family life lesson, no_fact is arguable.
